ai.overview: UCLA brings the Women's College Basketball Belt home to face Lehigh in what appears to be a significant mismatch on paper. This marks Lehigh's first-ever opportunity to claim the belt, though they'll need to pull off a monumental upset against a UCLA squad that finished 37-1.

The Bruins' defense that held Texas to 44 points in the playoffs against a Lehigh offense that managed just 62 in their last outing
Can Lehigh (17-16) find any answers against a UCLA team that hasn't lost since finishing 37-1 and beat elite competition by double digits throughout their championship run?
